scope: Additive Locked decisions. All previous Locked decisions preserved.

decisions.decision: Every admitted user may rename any of their own setups. Preserve equipment history and shot provenance.

The last explicitly logged Slow Feed choice persists per setup across cloud sessions. Standard Feed makes the next default off; offline stale uploads cannot undo newer selections; unknown historical feed remains unknown. Preference is recorded on the active setup version.

Edit is the primary left action; Make Current Recipe is a separate right action. Eligible Dialed In shots automatically refine their family window; Make Current explicitly chooses a preferred family/example.
Use shot-card width and height efficiently to group measurements, setup, basket dose, feed, style, date and badges above sensory detail without crowding.
Manual export and import remain available under a collapsed Recovery options section in Settings; cloud sync and automatic offsite backups are the normal behavior.
decisions.amendment_note: Owner approved removal of routine Recovery UI on 2026-10-15. Original policy retained as decision history.

decisions.topic: Automatic publishing and multi-system revision consistency
decisions.decision: After the user-approved development changes pass required tests and safety checks, promptly publish them to the existing SSO-protected owner Netlify site, without a separate per-change approval request. Keep GitHub implementation, applied Supabase migrations, Netlify deployed commit, and specification/decision ledger consistent; verify the published deploy. When publishing is blocked, disclose the blocker and request only the smallest required user action, never claim it is live.
decisions.safeguards: Preserve all other Locked decisions: SSO access, beta admission, import recovery gate, database RLS and data integrity, private production constraints, and original local prototype. Automated publication is for owner development, not authorization to launch external beta or apply unrelated migrations. A failed deploy never replaces the currently published site.
acceptance_checks: Required Supabase migrations applied and schema/source matched
Netlify latest ready/published commit matches GitHub approved head
Netlify SSO remains required; existing import gate unchanged
decisions.implementation_status: Git-linked Netlify confirmed by owner screenshot, latest deploy still stale at time of request; Netlify branch/build settings remain to be verified.
decisions.amendment_note: The owner changed the release cadence on 2026-10-14: publishing remains automatic after testing but must be deliberately batched to preserve Netlify Free credits, not triggered on every intermediate GitHub commit. All non-cadence safeguards remain Locked.

decisions.status: Implementing in GitHub. Netlify is presently credit-paused; effectiveness on a live Netlify build remains to be confirmed after a future funded billing cycle.
decisions.decision: Replace per-intermediate-commit publication with one intentionally consolidated, tested owner-preview production release per finished bundle. Carry out intermediate development, review, Node/mobile regression tests, and Supabase migrations in GitHub/Supabase without routine billable Netlify production publishes. Continue automatic publication after the bundle has passed gates only when a fresh, verified Netlify credit balance is sufficient; verify the published SHA and protections.
decisions.deployment_controls: A Git-connected production deploy must have explicit 'Release DIC: ... [dic-publish]' commit subject, run the existing test/build command, and pass the fail-closed credit snapshot gate. Non-release pushes are skipped; 0-credit PR/branch previews are permitted. Netlify build hooks can bypass ignore and must not be used for unreviewed releases.
decisions.current_credit_snapshot: Owner Netlify screenshot 2026-10-14: Free 300 included; 22 production deploys used 330 credits; 0.1 requests; 0.1 bandwidth; 330.2 total, zero remaining. Free production publishing paused. This is not proof of a charge or debt.
decisions.data_accuracy_caveat: Netlify connector cannot retrieve live billing totals: docs/NETLIFY_CREDIT_LEDGER.json is a point-in-time verified ledger. Refresh from provider before each intended release or billing-cycle reset. Never claim a stale balance is current.
decisions.financial_constraints: No upgrade, credit purchase, auto-recharge, new provider, or changed visitor access without separate owner approval.
decisions.unchanged_requirements: Preserve SSO, owner preview/beta gates, RLS, import guard, database restoration obligations, Master Specification and all other Locked decisions.

decisions.topic: Automatic verified coffee approval and earliest canonical naming
decisions.decision: Owner-administrator's own new coffees auto-approve atomically after duplicate/conflict checks. Other admitted users' nonconflicting new entries are always saved atomically; trusted official roaster source evidence can auto-verify them. Fuzzy near-matches ask the user before reuse or merging; the earliest entered original coffee name remains the shared canonical display name. Admin review only for genuinely uncertain/irreconcilable conflicts. Preserve library IDs and shots on merges.
decisions.amends: Prior rule that all new coffee entries must remain Pending until admin review is superseded only where the owning admin explicitly enters a coffee or a new user's coffee passes the trusted official-source automated verification. Unknown/uncertain or source-unverified releases remain usable Pending and not community eligible.
decisions.integrity: First submitted spelling retained globally; no older canonical changed merely because a later user spelled a roaster/coffee differently. Protect different harvests, source variants, producer/origin conflicts, account isolation and all shot/family relationships. Explicit stable-id confirmation is allowed only for compatible Pending-to-canonical matches.
decisions.operational: No service subscription required, no AI calls; source workers limited to curated official HTTPS product URLs, JWT authorization, manual redirect rejection, bounded HTML and rate limits. GitHub/Supabase remain source of truth while Netlify credit-paused.
decisions.implementation_status: Core Supabase auto catalog and source worker target applied; real owner's four coffee submissions approved; Edge function and browser CI integration under test, Netlify intentionally unpublished.

decisions.decision: Use https://app.dialincollective.com for the application and admin portal on the existing protected Netlify site. Reserve dialincollective.com for a future homepage; until ready, redirect the apex to the app only after verified TLS, login callbacks, and SSO.
decisions.constraints: No new site, purchase, extra production deployment, weakening of auth/SSO/beta restrictions, or changes to the independent auth.dialincollective.com email subdomain. DNS, HTTPS and Supabase redirects must be verified separately.
decisions.implementation_status: Verified 2026-10-15: app.dialincollective.com is the existing Netlify project's primary domain with Let's Encrypt HTTPS; owner opened app and completed real existing-account sign-in; Supabase Site URL and Redirect allowlist updated by owner while preserving netlify.app fallback; Cloudflare apex dialincollective.com redirects to app domain; existing Resend Auth sender and Cloudflare support forwarding were each confirmed via real email receipts. Existing Netlify team SSO remains enabled. Updated cloud UI and outside-user login are still awaiting a single controlled release and real nonadmin acceptance.
decisions.verification_basis: Owner-confirmed browser/screenshots plus connected Netlify site/deploy state, not a new production deployment.
